description: Finds agent sessions of one provider, most recent first: start here to get the session ids every other per-session tool needs. Filter by a title/id substring, a start-date window, a repository and a project; each session names its repository key (null with unattributedReason when it has none) and project. `total` is the number of matches before `limit`, so you can tell whether to narrow the search.

projectId.description: Only sessions in this project (an id from list_projects).

provider.description: Log provider id, e.g. "claude-code", "vscode", "pi-agent", "mitmproxy" (see list_log_providers). Defaults to the provider active in the web app.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring of the session title or id.

repository.description: Only sessions in this repository (a key from list_repositories).

since.description: Earliest session start, inclusive: "YYYY-MM-DD" or an ISO timestamp.

until.description: Latest session start, inclusive: "YYYY-MM-DD" or an ISO timestamp.

name: list_sessions
title: List sessions
